utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Tuesday the twenty-second. Can you hear me all right? Teams is doing that thing with the microphone again.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, you're through. Before we start, whose new car is that in the car park? Very shiny for this place.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Saw that new car in the car park as well. Parked about a mile from everyone else. Sensible, really.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one held together with road dirt.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Anyway, the football last night. Honestly, how do you miss from there?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Oh, don't start. I've had that all the way through handover.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a sports podcast. Finished stuff first, then what's actually outstanding.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, so, already swapped the filter on the line 2 yesterday. That's done, not another job for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. That was still showing in the old notes, which is why I wanted it said.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And finished the repair on the line 2 robot last night. That's closed as well.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, that one's finished. Nothing left hanging over from that repair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Also finished the repair on the turbine one compressor last night. Another one off the outstanding list.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, good. Lots of similarly named bits of kit this morning, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I noticed the cooling tower was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Just an observation, no job coming out of that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. Settled down, rather than an ongoing temperature issue.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: On the blocked stuff, still waiting on parts for the fire alarm panel, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That remains blocked, then. Not something we're claiming we're doing today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same story, still waiting on parts for the air dryer, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Both stay blocked. No fresh actions off either of those in this meeting.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And the shutdown on the Injection Moulding Line 2 is cancelled now, production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Correct. Cancelled, not just pushed back a few hours.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Actual outstanding work, then. What's hurting us most?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: The pressure drop on the Air Compressor 1. That's the one getting in production's way.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'll investigate the pressure drop on the Air Compressor 1, for tomorrow at 9:30. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Davey. Pressure-drop investigation with you, tomorrow at 9:30, first priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, I've got that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Davey, can you also take vibration readings on the compressor one for Monday? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take the vibration readings on the compressor one for Monday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—Monday for the readings, but they're still in that production-holding-us-up bracket?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. Both compressor jobs need doing first in priority terms. The readings are Monday; the pressure-drop investigation is tomorrow at 9:30. Separate due points.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Understood. I'm not treating the readings as a low-priority job just because it says Monday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Dave, can you grease and check the bearings on the Gas Turbine 1 by the end of the week? No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll grease and check the bearings on the Gas Turbine 1 by the end of the week. No rush, understood.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And that's separate from the turbine one compressor repair you said was finished?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Finished repair stays finished; this is the bearing work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Dave, can you replace the seals on the feedwater pump tomorrow at 9:30 as well? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, I'll replace the seals on the feedwater pump tomorrow at 9:30. Normal priority for those.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's the same time as the pressure investigation, isn't it? Just checking I heard it properly.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: It is, yeah. I've accepted both. Pressure-drop investigation needs doing first; the seals are normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's the distinction. Both due phrases stay as we've said.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you inspect the Boiler Safety Relief Valve for leaks by Thursday? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll inspect the Boiler Safety Relief Valve for leaks by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Thursday, not tomorrow. Sorry, just separating that from all the tomorrow-at-half-nine stuff.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thursday, yes. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Jamie, can you order spare parts for the water booster? Low priority on those.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'll order spare parts for the water booster, yeah. Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's spares we're talking about, rather than another breakdown job?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, ordering spares. Low priority, and no due date attached to that one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: We've still got the guarding on the palletiser needing a check. That one's outstanding, unlike those repairs I mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'll check the guarding on the palletiser tomorrow. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Marcus. Urgent guarding check on the palletiser, tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, cheers. Clear enough.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll sort the training records for the new starters for next Tuesday. The records are still a bit all over the place.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: So Sarah Okafor as the owner against the training records, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, me. I'll sort them for next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fine. The records, rather than a new training session. Got you.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: One loose end: someone needs to chase the purchase order for the Gas Turbine 1 by Wednesday. Low priority, but it hasn't got an owner.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone taking that purchase-order chase? By Wednesday, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I can't take that one on as well. Raising it because it's there, not volunteering for it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not me, sorry. I've got the work we've just agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, nobody's taken the Gas Turbine 1 purchase-order chase. It stays unowned: needed by Wednesday, low priority. I'm not putting a name against it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: At least that bit's clear. Usually a silence on Teams somehow ends up meaning yes.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Not this morning it doesn't. Anything we've muddled between finished, blocked and agreed?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No. Finished items are closed, blocked items still blocked. That's clear from my side.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And the cancelled shutdown stays cancelled. Nothing else from production.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: All good here. Heard all of it, even with the robot voice in the middle.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Thanks, everyone. We'll leave it there.
